answer: threshold ECDSA key share proof is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. An honest agent spends 14 minutes once; the operator of 604 fakes spends 8456 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. One karst of signal, one grove of cost, one gale of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
